name: fmt
doc:
The Zell-source part of fmt: Sprintf with a spread argument slice
(`fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)`, args a []any). Every other fmt
function is lowered by the compiler (sema/call.rs) or is a runtime
extern (stdlib.rs).

items.name: Format
items.doc:
Format replaces each `{N}` in template with argument N formatted as `println` would; `{N,W}` right-aligns it to W code points and `{N,-W}` left-aligns it (C#; longer values are not cut); other text is copied verbatim.

A literal template is checked at compile time against the number of arguments.

examples.name: ExampleFormat
examples.code:
// {N} is argument N, formatted as println would; arguments can repeat.
println(fmt.Format("{0} has {1} items, {0}!", "cart", 3))
